standards_review.notes: All 4 commits in the review range have a lowercase first word after the colon, violating the documented ^EPMCDME-\d+:\s[A-Z][a-z]*.* regex. Subjects: 'un-gate categories filter for my/all workflow scopes' (commit a91402c), 'add categories field to visual editor GeneralConfigTab' (5e94ceb), 'add categories field to workflow text-editor form path' (3e1418f), 'add categories to Workflow type and baseWorkflowSchema' (035ec7f).
.ai-run/guides/standards/code-quality.md is absent from the repository; no standard to adjudicate against.
No HTML sinks (dangerouslySetInnerHTML, innerHTML), untrusted navigation, cross-window message handlers, credential exposure, or nosonar suppressions introduced in any of the 10 changed files.

blocking_findings.violation: git-workflow.md requires the first word after the colon to start with uppercase (regex [A-Z][a-z]*). All four commit subjects begin with lowercase: 'un-gate' and 'add' (x3).
blocking_findings.why_blocking: Tekton CI enforces the commit-message regex and blocks the pipeline on violations.
blocking_findings.remedy: Reword all four subjects so the first word is capitalised: e.g. 'Un-gate categories filter for my/all workflow scopes' and 'Add categories field to visual editor GeneralConfigTab', etc.
